author: The B1M
description:
I know from personal experience how hard it can be to talk about your mental health 🙏

It's why I am so pleased to see the British Standards Institution's (BSI) new practical resource pack and guide for talking about suicide in construction published today, and to have played a part in helping put it together alongside so many fantastic organisations and experts.

The guide is available to download for free via the BSI website.

You can learn more about my work to improve mental health in construction at getconstructiontalking.org
title: How YOU Can Help Improve MENTAL HEALTH in Construction
